components.name: Code surface
components.description: Flat readable surface for commands and configuration.
components.css: .ds-code { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 22px; align-items: center; padding: 19px 21px; color: #1c2940; background: #e6f0dc; font: 14px/1.65 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; } .ds-code button { color: #4055a8; background: transparent; border: 0; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-code button:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-code button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #4055a8; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: A concise technical document: one readable column, system monospace, real code, and explicit links.

rules.name: Evidence Is Content
rules.body: Use real commands and configuration instead of promotional containers.

dos: Keep the page as one readable technical document.
donts: Do not use pale gray for necessary information.
Do not add marketing-card grids or oversized empty regions.
